setup: The functions are \(f(x) = [[f]]\) and \(g(x) = [[g]]\), evaluated at \(x = [[x]]\).

steps.say: The value of the first function is \(f([[x]]) = [[f_value]]\).
The value of the second function is \(g([[x]]) = [[g_value]]\).
Composing gives \((f \circ g)([[x]]) = [[f_of_g]]\), \((g \circ f)([[x]]) = [[g_of_f]]\) and \((f \circ f)([[x]]) = [[f_of_f]]\).

answer: The three compositions at \(x = [[x]]\) are [[f_of_g]], [[g_of_f]] and [[f_of_f]].
